labels.text:
1  BAY ENCLOSURE -> motor body
3x M2x10 countersunk (Phillips) UP from under the robot,
through the tongue into the deck
3x M2x10 CSK from below, 4 mm into the deck

2  SERVO ADAPTER (Waveshare A)  - no screws:
slides down into the rib slots. Solder first, on its back pins:
5 V in (DC+ DC-, 20 AWG) and UART TX RX GND.
Cap the 3 front UART pins (tape)

3  IMU BNO086 - onto the 4 pegs on the rear wall (no screws),
hot glue on the peg tips. Qwiic cable into its RIGHT socket first

5  BATTERY 3S 850 mAh (60 x 30 x 20) - hook-and-loop on the floor.
Leads + balance lead out of the rear-right window

6  XT30 pair + balance plug - rear-right cradle, 1 zip tie.
Unplug here; charge through the balance plug here

7  MINI560 5 V - solder 4 wires from below (20 AWG),
slide into the lid's slot, parts UP through the window

8  LID - 4x M2x6 socket into the bay posts
(before the Uno Q: it covers them)

9  UNO Q - 3x M3x8 + 1x M2x6 (hole by the digital header).
Plugs: 3-pin right-angle on JANALOG 6-7-8 (UART GND, GND, VIN)
- mark + hot-glue; 2-pin on D0/D1; Qwiic; USB adapter

10 USB-C -> USB-A right-angle adapter, mouth DOWN;
camera plug in the rear-left cradle, 1 zip tie
11 UNO Q COVER (optional) - 2x M2x6 through its sides
